module: Module 4: Order Execution, Modification & Bulk Routing
title: Broker Requote / Price Off Quotes Handling on Parent Order
precondition: Master attempts instant order during illiquid market; broker requotes.
expected_result: Child orders NOT sent until master accepts or rejects requote; zero partial child order orphan execution.
actual_result: Requote or price rejection on master block blocks downstream fan-out, preventing orphan child executions.

evidence.concurrency_rule: Parent fill pre-requisite for child execution
